name: nimbus-drive
description: Self-hosted personal cloud drive — your files on your own machine, from anywhere

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix web run start"
